preflight: Install hash-checked package/client on B, preserving old guard and state; no second chain executor.
Confirm B clock, free storage, actual custody and trusted native/CPU artifacts.
Read actual synced TN10/active lane/UTXOs and quote/mass/fees for signed native steps.
Before rental obtain separate release and actual one-L40S/storage quote fitting USD5 planning.
Read provider creation time/image digest/resources/persistent volume; bind unchanged B guard <=7200s from actual creation.
Read service scope, policy hash and unused volume/ledger; require fresh B heartbeat and >3960s remaining.
stageWorkflow: Use actual accepted chain data and PR52 tooling to freeze the next batch target locally.
Retain target/input/journal and exact target SHA independently on B before upload.
Approve only that next SHA, upload its four-file public bundle; poll instead of retrying on lost response.
Copy/hash-check results to B and verify exact receipt with trusted CPU executable and independent target.
Prepare and locally execute fully signed native settlement/payout, budgets/masses/fees; actual broadcast still needs live release.
Observe actual selected-chain native acceptance; next capture begins at the preceding proof endpoint, including interim settlements.
stopAndRecovery: One deadline starts with first accepted proof stage and includes chain waits; no reset after connection/service restart.
Active service restart interrupts saved process group and forbids retry. Waiting restart keeps deadline/order and needs a fresh B heartbeat.
Keep candidate/partial evidence; never label partial/CUDA-inconclusive output successful.
Unchanged independent B guard saves durable archives and confirms provider EXITED on every outcome.
Delete Pod/storage only after external hash and independent CPU verification; confirm deletion.
